decisions.evidence: Taken together, the three positive neighbors and the three negative neighbors all point in the same final direction: the query repeatedly shows the mutagenic-leaning pattern of higher basicity, higher logP, lower QED, and in several cases higher heteroatom or ring content, with only partial offsets from higher polar surface area or a few opposing charge-related features. The balance of the six local comparisons therefore supports option (B): is mutagenic.
